title: A transient depth-averaged lava flow model with a Herschel-Bulkley rheology accounting for three phases
summary: This study presents a three-phase suspension lava flow model with a Herschel-Bulkley rheology. The suspension contains crystals and gas bubbles, and two closures for the evolution of the crystal volume fraction are considered. The first closure minimizes the complexity of the system by treating crystal fraction as a transported quantity subject to relaxation towards an equilibrium state. This closure avoids a parametrization of the many heat transfer mechanisms a lava flow is subjected to.
